dimensions.fingerprint_note: This edition holds runs under two fingerprints: interface v10 and v10.1, a minor revision of it. A climb continued above Ascension 5 after the cap was raised plays its higher ascensions under v10.1 whichever version its first six were played under; its own page says which. v10.1 says which card reward is open when a rewards screen has two or more, and shows a rejected action as it was sent. Nothing else the model sees changed: replayed under v10.1, this edition's v10 runs differ at no more than 1.2% of any row's decision points.
